turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Good morning, Orion Shield Insurance, Rahul speaking. How may I help you?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, I've been waiting weeks for an update on my claim. This is unacceptable and I'd like to complain.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: That sounds like a really tough few days. Let's get this sorted out for you. Before I ask for a few details, I need to let you know that this call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Can I take your full name and date of birth, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Imran Rahman, 20 July 1980.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. And can you confirm your policy number or postcode?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's RX6 1QA.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you've been waiting weeks for an update on your claim and you'd like to complain. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm really sorry about the delay. I can log a formal complaint, which we acknowledge within 3 working days, or arrange for a supervisor to call you back within 24 hours. Which would you prefer?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: A supervisor callback, please.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Can you tell me roughly when you made the claim?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: About three weeks ago.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, I've recorded all of that on your file.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will I get some compensation for this?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can't promise a particular outcome, but your complaint will be looked at properly.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: That's not good enough, surely someone can fix this today?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I completely understand why that's frustrating, but I'm not able to make an exception, it's a fixed term of the policy. I'm happy to explain how it works if that helps.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me just check that for you, would you mind if I place you on a brief hold?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sure, no problem.

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.text: [On hold 1:08]

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for holding, I appreciate your patience. Claims are normally acknowledged within 24 hours and assessed within 10 working days once we have all the documents.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Mr Rahman. I've logged this under reference REQ-55483, and our claims team will contact you with an update.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've logged your complaint and chased your claim.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
